title.narrative: Joint UNIDO-SMEDA-Italia programme to establish an Investment Promotion (IPU) in Lahore with emphasis on Italian investment in Pakistan

description.narrative: This project provides for the establishment and operation for three years of an IPU in the offices of SMEDA in Lahore for the purpose of promoting foreign, and especially Italian, investment in industrial SMEs in Pakistan, and thereby to enhance their productivity and international competitiveness. To maximize its developmental impact, this project will be closely interlinked with other ongoing UNIDO activities in the field of SME development in Pakistan according to modalities to be determined by the Steering Committee.
